term: can, duty retention, action identity and retrospective responsibility
resolution: Practical ability at after differs from ability at some later date and from actual fulfillment. The generic imported compatibility theorem is instantiated over dates with a supplied ideal-date frame; its earlier continuation interpretation is not asserted identical. Returning the original object is not compensation or debt repayment. Retrospective responsibility can remain when the present original-return duty lapses. No permission or moral truth follows from the predicate names. Attribution of the working reconstruction is deferred. Plan alternatives are complete dated futures, not Stage dates; FeasibleAbility quantifies over a feasible alternative, independently of the designated actual branch. Date-only FutureCan is a separate narrower ability control.
